text:
maya: FYI we're seeing unexpected duplicate invoice lines after flipping price-sheet gamma-v2 to 15% cohort in eu-central. ~10 accounts affected, mostly small amounts but one is ~$620.
ben: can you paste the diagnostic query you ran?
maya: ran: ```sql
SELECT account_id, billing_key, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(amount_usd) total
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE price_sheet='gamma-v2' AND created_at >= '2026-03-24' AND region='eu-central'
GROUP BY account_id, billing_key HAVING COUNT(*)>1 LIMIT 50;
```
maya: results match the 10 accounts; duplicates within 1-2 minutes of each other.
liam: could be overlap between realtime apply and grandfathering job. what's grandfather_ttl?
maya: grandfather_ttl=1800s for this rollout.
sara: tagging ops-bot: @ops-bot run dedupe scan for 2026-03-24 06:00-07:00 UTC and check for repeated request_id or duplicate billing_key writes.
ops-bot: running dedupe scan for window 06:00-07:00 UTC. will report in ~2m.
ben: finance: proposal for immediate mitigation: 1) flip cohort back to legacy for eu-central, 2) authorize auto-credit up to $500/account for duplicates, 3) open tickets for manual review >$500. Approve?
ben: I pre-approve up to $500/account for emergency credits pending final reconciliation. >$500 escalate to finance leads. :white_check_mark:
maya: ops please schedule rollback at 06:12 UTC if ops-bot confirms duplicates.
ops-bot: dedupe scan complete: found 1.2k duplicate invoice events tied to ingestion shard-2; root cause likely overlapping writes from gf-job + realtime apply. digest: /var/logs/ingest/gamma-dedupe-2035001234.log
liam: flipping feature flag `pricing_cohort_router.gamma_v2` -> false at 2026-03-24T06:12:45Z. verifying routing...
liam: smoke-check: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_routing WHERE variant='gamma-v2' AND region='eu-central'; -> 0. rollback complete.
sara: created FIN-4832 for bulk credit batch and FIN-4833..FIN-4842 for top accounts. assigning to billing ops.
maya: putting note on experiment dashboard: "paused due to duplicate invoice lines from overlapping grandfathering; rollback applied 06:12 UTC. credits authorized."
ben: billing ops please proceed with bulk credits for <=$500 and list any >$500 for manual approval. tag me on those tickets.
sara: bulk credit job queued; dry-run succeeded. estimate credits complete in ~60m.
maya: I'll run reconciliation and post net revenue impact for cohort by EOD. also adding rollout SOP item: pause grandfathering job for 5m before flip.
ops-bot: created INF-3420: "ingest: safe-guard overlapping writes during price rollouts" assigned to eng-infra. link: https://b.internal/INF-3420
ben: thanks team. leave thread open until reconciliation posted.
ops-bot: archival reminder: thread auto-archives in 90 days.
